test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A ball of radius 10 cm is taken and a cylindrical hole of radius 1 cm is drilled through the centre. Which of the options listed below is the closest in value to the ratio of the total surface area of the hollowed out ball to the surface area of the original ball?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio = [Remaining **Spherical Area** + Inner **Cylindrical Area**] ÷ Original **Surface Area**

Ratio = [2πRh + 2πrh] ÷ 4πR² = [h(R + r)] ÷ 2R², where h = 2√(R² − r²)

Ratio = [2√(10² − 1²) × (10 + 1)] ÷ (2 × 10²) = [11 × √99] ÷ 100

Ratio ≈ [11 × 9.9498] ÷ 100 ≈ 1.0945

Comparing with options: 219/200 = 1.095, which is the closest value.

**∴ The correct answer is 219/200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the ball (**R**) = 10 cm

Radius of the cylindrical hole (**r**) = 1 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e81d4e7c962737bc4801ad119a32f11591453a52fe449b29411b26be534a3fe0.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of original sphere = 4πR²

Surface area of spherical zone = 2πRh

Lateral surface area of cylinder = 2πrh

Height of the hole (**h**) = 2√(R² − r²)

**Calculations:**

⇒ h = 2 × √(10² − 1²) = 2 × √99 = 2 × 3√11 = 6√11 cm

⇒ Surface area of original ball = 4 × π × 10² = 400π cm²

⇒ Total Surface Area of hollowed ball = Area of **Spherical Zone** + Area of **Internal Cylinder**

⇒ Total S.A. = 2πRh + 2πrh = 2πh(R + r)

⇒ Total S.A. = 2 × π × (6√11) × (10 + 1) = 132π√11 cm²

⇒ Ratio = (132π√11) ÷ (400π) = (33√11) ÷ 100

⇒ √11 ≈ 3.3166

⇒ Ratio ≈ (33 × 3.3166) ÷ 100 = 109.4478 ÷ 100 = 1.094478

⇒ Checking Option 1: 219 ÷ 200 = 1.095

**∴ The correct answer is 219/200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Spherical Zone Area

The surface area of a portion of a sphere between two parallel planes is 2πRh, where h is the perpendicular distance between the planes.

Spherical Cap Area

The surface area of a spherical cap is 2πRh꜀ₐₚ, where h꜀ₐₚ is the height of the cap.

Napkin Ring Problem

The volume of the remaining part of the sphere (the napkin ring) depends only on the height h of the hole: V = (πh³)/6.</p
